Subject: Quick ask — can we quote the pilot and use Redwood logo in our announcement?

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the help this quarter — the pilot rolled into our internal benchmark today and we have materially better LLM latency on our inference path with Redwood. Our comms team wants to push a short customer announcement next week.

Two asks:
- Can we include a short quote: "Nebula Systems reduced inference latency by ~35% using Redwood Inference during our pilot" — we can adjust the wording if legal prefers.
- Permission to use the Redwood logo (square mark + wordmark) in the announcement and in a small press kit.

I've attached a one-page draft of the announcement and the PR timeline (attachment: nebula_pr_draft.docx). We are ready to sign the order form to expand to production — procurement asked for your standard Order Form redline earlier today.

If there are guardrails you need (embargo timing, anonymized quote, logo usage specs), tell me and we'll follow them. Can you loop in whatever team needs to approve?

Thanks,
Sarah

Marissa / Alex — forwarding Sarah's note. Quick summary: Nebula wants a short quote and permission to use the Redwood logo in a customer announcement next week. They also say procurement has an Order Form ready.

Marketing/PR perspective: we typically allow logo + short quote for pilots if we get:
- Explicit written approval of final PR text (we'll sign off before publish)
- A 48h embargo to coordinate quotes and press lists
- Usage confined to Nebula's website/press material and partner pages (no sublicensing)

Legal/Contracts (Alex) — can you advise on the Order Form / MSA redlines? Procurement asked for a final signed order form to proceed; I can tell them we need a short turnaround for logo approval and add the embargo language.

I've attached the logo asset package we provide (redwood_logo_approved.zip) and I'm including the PR draft so you can see context.

Thanks,
Irene

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, alex.martinez@redwood.com
Cc: sarah@nebulasys.com
Date: 2026-08-19 11:40 PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — can we quote the pilot and use Redwood logo in our announcement?

Thanks for the ping, Irene. Marketing is OK to approve with the following conditions:

1) Final text approval — please route the final PR draft to marketing 24 hours before publish for sign-off. We will only request cosmetic edits (brand wording and logo placement).

2) Approved attribution line — we require the short attribution to read: "Powered by Redwood Inference" (we prefer this over full quote attribution for pilot announcements). If Nebula insists on the longer latency stat, we ask for either: (a) anonymized phrasing (e.g., "reduced latency in their pilot") OR (b) a signed data claim attestation from Nebula's engineering team verifying the 35% number.

3) Logo usage — use the square mark at no larger than 150px in media kits and ensure the logo is not used as a product badge (i.e., not directly on screenshots implying co-branding). We will provide a one-page logo usage guide (included in redwood_logo_approved.zip).

Irene, Alex — can Contracts add a short publicity clause to the Order Form addendum: limited marketing permission, 90-day revocation window if either party requests removal, and prohibition on sublicensing the logo. We prefer to keep reference rights limited and avoid press quotes being framed as a case study without a separate case study approval.

Sarah — happy to work through the exact wording. If you want, marketing can draft a preferred attribution sentence tomorrow and share.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Marketing Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_logo_approved.zip (logo usage + guide)
From: Tomas Berger <tomas@bergerlaw.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, alex.martinez@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, sarah@nebulasys.com
Date: 2026-08-20 16:02 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we quote the pilot and use Redwood logo in our announcement? — redlines attached

Irene / Alex / Marissa — attaching a single redline for the Order Form publicity addendum that Nebula's counsel is proposing (attachment: MSA_redline_v2.pdf). High level comments in the redline:
- Nebula wants a perpetual, nonexclusive right to refer to Redwood as a customer/partner in marketing materials.
- They propose a standard 30-day removal notice for logo takedown (we typically ask for shorter windows).
- They request a carve-out to quote specific performance numbers without additional proof beyond the pilot report.

We are inline on narrowing those asks, but wanted to surface a couple of negotiation points:
1) Publicity scope — Redwood's ask to prohibit sublicensing and to limit to announcement + website is reasonable; Nebula is seeking broader partner references.
2) Data claims — Nebula wishes to avoid producing a signed engineering attestation; instead they propose the language: "to the best of Nebula's knowledge". That is weaker than Redwood's preference.
3) Embargo and approval — Nebula would like a 24-hour approval window and oppose a 48-hour embargo.

Next steps I propose:
- Alex: counter with a 48-hour sign-off for any quote that includes numbers OR require a short attestation email from their engineering lead (we can accept emailed attestation on letterhead).
- Marissa: we can offer the "Powered by Redwood Inference" attribution and logo asset accompanied by the usage guide.
- Irene: if we agree to a limited perpetual reference right for standard partner mentions (not full case study), ensure the Order Form explicitly excludes case study content which must be negotiated separately.

Sarah — we can move quickly if Nebula is OK with the above. I've uploaded the signed order form they had earlier for your records (forwarded: Nebula_OrderForm_Signed.pdf).

Thanks,
Tomas Berger
Counsel, Berger & Winters (for Nebula Systems)
Attachment: MSA_redline_v2.pdf (redlined publicity/press clauses)
Attachment: Nebula_OrderForm_Signed.pdf (forwarded signed order form)
